user.title: Set up SwitchBot Segments
user.description: Pick a neon strip. The list comes from the devices already set up in the SwitchBot Bluetooth integration.

abort.already_configured: This strip is already set up here.
abort.no_devices: No matching strip found. Set up the neon strip in the SwitchBot Bluetooth integration first (Home Assistant 2026.8 or newer).

set_segments.name: Set segments
set_segments.description: Colours individual segments of a neon strip; all other segments stay as they are.

strip.name: Strip
strip.description: The SwitchBot Segments entry of the strip.

segments.name: Segments
segments.description: List of entries with "segments" (e.g. "0-13, 20", 0-based) and "color" ([r, g, b]).

snapshot.name: Save colours
snapshot.description: Reads all segment colours from the strip and stores them under a name.

strip.name: Strip
strip.description: The SwitchBot Segments entry of the strip.

restore.name: Restore colours
restore.description: Restores saved segment colours; only the differences are sent.

strip.name: Strip
strip.description: The SwitchBot Segments entry of the strip.

apply_preset.name: Apply preset
apply_preset.description: Brings the strip to a preset saved in the panel; the previous state is kept as snapshot "vor_aenderung".

strip.name: Strip
strip.description: The SwitchBot Segments entry of the strip.

apply_template.name: Apply template
apply_template.description: Colours the strip from a template that uses the sections between the corners set in the panel; the previous state is kept as snapshot "vor_aenderung".

strip.name: Strip
strip.description: The SwitchBot Segments entry of the strip.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: List of [r, g, b]. Corner accent: base colour first, then accent.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: Colour steps of a gradient; each step costs at least one command.

accent_width.name: Accent width
accent_width.description: Corner accent: segments to the left and right of each corner.

init.title: Transition and timing
init.description: Takes effect immediately, no reload needed. Every command waits for the strip to confirm – fewer segments per command means more commands and a longer change.

data.live_delay_ms: Live display delay in the panel

data_description.transition: Wipe: the change runs along the strip. Direct: grouped by colour, as few commands as possible.
data_description.wipe_min_changed: Smaller changes (e.g. while painting) are always direct.
data_description.frame_delay_ms: Extra pause while wiping, if it runs through too quickly.
data_description.live_delay_ms: Wait after painting or dragging corners before the strip is updated.
